title: 第1章 觉醒混沌体获混沌吞噬塔第2章 夺骨之恨废轮之仇
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: “父亲，苏昊已经派人传来消息，必须將苏辰逐出家族，否则的话，苏族会执行家法，清理门户。”
他已经废了苏辰的血轮，难道还要赶尽杀绝吗？当年三弟要是不出事，他也不敢那般做，可怜的苏辰刚刚觉醒帝骨，就被苏昊强行剥夺。”
“苏昊乃是整个苏族的第一天才，如今更是达到了巔峰实丹境，难道为了一个废人赔上整个家族吗？”
东荒。
盘鼎皇朝。
盘幽城，苏家。
坐在大堂上首位的老者，饱经风霜的脸上写满了阴沉，漆黑的双眸犹如两座无尽深渊，让人感到不寒而慄。
“父亲，苏昊已经承诺，只要家族逐出苏辰，便可以让苏阳前往苏族，进入苏族修炼，苏阳已经觉醒血轮，顺利筑基。”
“闭嘴。”
看到父亲动了真怒，苏玄不敢再说话。
眼神越发森冷，苏渊双拳紧紧握著，他岂能不明白苏昊的意思，却没有丝毫的办法。
盘幽城苏家，只是苏族的一个小小分支，只要苏族愿意，动动手指都可以轻鬆覆灭苏家。
当年苏昊当眾剥离苏辰刚刚觉醒的帝骨，苏家上下没有一人敢出手阻止，也是因为此事，他愧疚了整整十年。
天荒大陆，武者为尊。
武者境界分为后天境，先天境，筑基境，金丹境，元婴境，魂宫境，凝神境……。
每个人六岁之时，体內都会觉醒血脉，唯有如此，才能够引天地灵力入体，突破先天境。
至於武者想要筑基，却需要血脉繁衍出血轮，以灵力入血轮筑基，可以这样说，无法繁衍血轮者，一生都无望筑基成功。
苏辰，六岁顺利觉醒血脉，更是觉醒了伴生帝骨，引动天地异象，绵延万里，惊动四方。
天生帝骨，必成帝境。
却不曾想到。
苏族的苏昊正好路过，看到天地异象，立刻出手剥夺苏辰的帝骨，只要没有融合帝骨，便可以强行剥离。
失去帝骨的苏辰，依然没有选择颓废和放弃，比別人更加刻苦，终於藉助血脉繁衍出血轮，更是筑基成功，成为苏家年轻一辈中，第一位筑基成功的人。
三天前，苏辰为了救治父亲苏战前往天罚森林寻找天魂草，却又偏偏遇到了苏昊。
苏昊故意废掉苏辰的血轮，却不杀掉苏辰，为的就是让苏辰继续活著，然后高高在上的俯视。
“辰儿醒过来，让他来见我。”
听到父亲的话，苏虹和苏玄两人都明白，父亲已经做出决定，为了整个家族，只能选择牺牲苏辰，將其逐出家族。
西北角，偏僻独院，很安静。
黄昏降临。
昏暗的房间內，床上躺著一位青年，英俊刚毅的脸上有著一丝丝痛苦，剑眉星目，唇红齿白，深邃的双眼紧紧闭著。
猛然睁开双眼，苏辰感受著体內传来撕心裂肺的疼痛，整张脸都惨白无比，犹如白纸一般。
“苏昊！”
天罚森林一战，他连苏昊的一招都没有抵挡下来，便被苏昊废掉血轮。
content_en:
"Father, Su Hao has sent someone to convey the news that Su Chen must be expelled from the family. Otherwise, the Su clan will enforce family laws and clean up the family."
"Hey!
He has disabled Su Chen's blood wheel, does he still want to kill them all? If nothing had happened to his third brother, he wouldn't have dared to do that. Poor Su Chen had just awakened the Emperor Bone and was forcibly deprived of it by Su Hao. "
"Su Hao is the number one genius in the entire Su clan, and now he has reached the peak level of alchemy. Should he sacrifice his entire family for a useless person?"
Donghuang.
Panding Dynasty.
Panyou City, Su Family.
The old man sitting at the head of the lobby had a weather-beaten face full of gloom, and his dark eyes were like two endless abyss, which made people shudder.
"Father, Su Hao has promised that as long as the family expels Su Chen, Su Yang can go to the Su Clan and enter the Su Clan to practice. Su Yang has awakened the blood wheel and successfully established the foundation."
"Shut up."
Seeing that his father was really angry, Su Xuan did not dare to speak anymore.
His eyes became colder and colder, and Su Yuan clenched his fists tightly. How could he not understand what Su Hao meant, but there was nothing he could do about it.
The Su family in Panyou City is just a small branch of the Su family. As long as the Su family is willing, they can easily destroy the Su family with a flick of their fingers.
When Su Hao peeled off Su Chen's newly awakened imperial bones in public, no one in the Su family dared to stop him. It was because of this that he felt guilty for ten years.
In the wild continent, warriors are respected.
The warrior realm is divided into acquired realm, innate realm, foundation building realm, golden elixir realm, Yuan Ying realm, soul palace realm, concentration realm...
When everyone is six years old, the bloodline will awaken in the body. Only in this way can the spiritual power of heaven and earth be introduced into the body and break through the innate realm.
As for warriors who want to build a foundation, they need blood to reproduce the blood wheel and use spiritual power to enter the blood wheel to build the foundation. It can be said that those who cannot reproduce the blood wheel have no hope of successfully building the foundation in their lifetime.
Su Chen successfully awakened his bloodline at the age of six, and even awakened the companion emperor bone, triggering visions in the world that stretched thousands of miles and shocked all directions.
Born with the bones of an emperor, he will definitely become an emperor.
But I never thought of it.
Su Hao from the Su Clan happened to be passing by. Seeing the strange phenomenon in the world, he immediately took action to deprive Su Chen of his imperial bones. As long as the imperial bones were not fused, he could forcefully peel them off.
Su Chen, who lost his imperial bones, still did not choose to be decadent and give up. He worked harder than others and finally used his bloodline to multiply the blood wheel. He also succeeded in building a foundation and became the first person among the younger generation of the Su family to successfully build a foundation.
Three days ago, Su Chen went to the Heavenly Punishment Forest to look for the Heavenly Soul Grass in order to save his father Su Zhan, but he happened to meet Su Hao again.
Su Hao deliberately destroyed Su Chen's blood wheel but did not kill Su Chen, just to let Su Chen continue to live and then look down from above.
"Chen'er wake up and let him come to see me."
After hearing their father's words, both Su Hong and Su Xuan understood that their father had made a decision. For the sake of the entire family, they could only choose to sacrifice Su Chen and expel him from the family.
~~~~~~~~
The northwest corner is a remote and private courtyard, very quiet.
Dusk falls.
In a dark room, there was a young man lying on the bed. There was a trace of pain on his handsome and resolute face, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, red lips and white teeth, and his deep eyes were tightly closed.
Opening his eyes suddenly, Su Chen felt the heartbreaking pain in his body, and his entire face was as pale as white paper.
"Su Hao!"
During the battle in the Heavenly Punishment Forest, he was unable to resist even one of Su Hao's moves, and his blood wheel was destroyed by Su Hao.
